ns2:section.sectionText: The class meets twice per week: once on Thursdays, and a second time to attend performances and/or exhibitions at Krannert Center for the Performing Arts and/or Krannert Art Museum. Event dates and times will vary. Students must be able to commit to attending the events on the syllabus. Admission to all events will be provided without charge to students enrolled in the course. On Thursdays at 1:30pm, the class will meet in Room 301 in Noyes Lab, located at 505 S. Mathews Avenue in Urbana. .
ns2:section.sectionDegreeAttributes: Humanities - Lit & Arts, and Camp Honors/Chanc Schol course.
